title: POOL: Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes
abstract: arXiv:2608.23086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Black-box large language models need confidence scores that can separate likely-correct from likely-incorrect outputs, enabling systems to prioritize human review, route uncertain cases to stronger models, or choose abstention thresholds on development data. Yet existing confidence estimators face a cost-quality trade-off: verbal confidence is cheap but is often overconfident, while sampling-based uncertainty is more informative but scales linearly with the number of samples per query. We propose \textsc{POOL} (\emph{Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes}),a cost-efficient framework that addresses this trade-off taking inspiration from group-testing.\textsc{POOL} clusters query stems with overlaps, evaluates a base estimator on representative medoids, softly propagates confidence scores to nearby queries, and selectively evaluates high-disagreement cases. translated_title: POOL：相似样本上的传播不确定性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23086v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：黑盒大型语言模型需要能够区分可能正确与可能错误输出的置信度分数，从而使系统能够优先安排人工审查、将不确定案例路由到更强的模型，或在开发数据上选择弃权阈值。然而，现有的置信度估计器面临成本-质量权衡：语言置信度便宜但常常过度自信，而基于采样的不确定性信息量更大，但随每个查询的样本数量线性扩展。我们提出POOL（相似样本上的传播不确定性），这是一个成本高效的框架，借鉴群体测试的思路来解决这一权衡。POOL对查询词干进行重叠聚类，在代表性中间点上评估基础估计器，将置信度分数软传播到邻近查询，并选择性评估高分歧案例。我们用Hy@p实例化该框架，这是一种混合估计器，结合了...
tldr: 本文提出POOL框架，通过聚类和传播置信度分数，在保持低计算成本的同时提升黑盒LLM的不确定性估计准确性，解决了成本与质量的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the POOL framework, which clusters and propagates confidence scores to improve uncertainty estimation accuracy for black-box LLMs while maintaining low computational cost, addressing the cost-quality trade-off.
